title: Customized Rice Biotechnology
for Research and Innovation.
hero.subtitle: Genetic transformation, gene editing, and molecular validation services for researchers, universities, and companies.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.description: Traditional plant breeding can take years. Gene editing offers a promising alternative, but it requires specialized infrastructure, qualified personnel, and complex protocols.

solution.title: Our Solution
solution.description: EditaOryza provides rice genetic transformation, gene editing, and molecular validation services, from gene construct development to plant generation and molecular analysis, without requiring clients to invest in their own specialized infrastructure.

title: Why Choose
EditaOryza?
why_choose_us.subtitle: We offer a comprehensive, specialized solution for rice genetic transformation and gene editing projects, focusing on results, quality, and technical support.

benefits.title: Integrated Process
benefits.description: From gene construct development to validated plants, we provide technical support throughout the different stages of each project.

benefits.title: Lower Investment
benefits.description: Access specialized infrastructure and expertise without having to establish your own laboratory.

benefits.title: Applied Biotechnology
benefits.description: We use modern genetic engineering techniques to develop solutions aligned with the needs of future agriculture.

benefits.title: Rice Specialists
benefits.description: Infrastructure and expertise in rice genetic transformation and gene editing, with protocol optimization tailored to Brazilian cultivars.

benefits.title: Greater Efficiency
benefits.description: We simplify complex technical procedures to facilitate research and innovation projects.

benefits.title: Strategic Partnership
benefits.description: We collaborate with researchers, universities, and companies to develop biotechnological solutions. We are a startup incubated at UFRGS, committed to innovation and research.

steps.title: Project Planning
steps.description: We understand your objectives and define the most appropriate biotechnology strategy for each project.

steps.title: Gene Construct Development
steps.description: We receive genetic constructs provided by the client or develop and prepare customized constructs according to the selected strategy and target trait.

steps.title: Genetic Transformation
steps.description: We introduce genetic material into rice cells using specialized protocols and infrastructure.

steps.title: Plant Regeneration
steps.description: We carry out the culture and regeneration of transformed cells to obtain plants.

steps.title: Molecular Validation
steps.description: We perform molecular analyses to confirm genetic transformation and editing, characterize the modifications introduced into the target gene, and verify the results obtained.

steps.title: Plant Material Delivery
steps.description: We deliver T1 seeds to support further research and the development of agricultural solutions.

institutional_guidelines.mission: To accelerate the development of more adaptable, efficient, and sustainable rice cultivars through genetic transformation and gene editing, promoting resilient agriculture and food security.
institutional_guidelines.vision: To become a leading reference in rice genetic transformation and gene editing in Brazil and Latin America, turning science and technology into solutions for developing more adaptable, resilient, and sustainable cultivars.
